description: This file implements UUID version 7 generation functions, including creating new UUIDs based on the current time and random data, with internal functions for time management and UUID formatting.

methods.name: NewV7
methods.description: Generates a new Version 7 UUID based on the current time, using a randomness pool if enabled.

methods.name: NewV7FromReader
methods.description: Generates a new Version 7 UUID based on the current time, filling random bits from the provided io.Reader.

methods.name: makeV7
methods.description: Fills a byte slice with UUID version 7 data, setting time and version bits.

methods.name: getV7Time
methods.description: Returns the current time in milliseconds and nanoseconds/256, ensuring monotonic increasing values.
